title: TURTLE OVERDRIVE - Endless arcade racer, built with Claude Code
author: namedropmusic
selftext:
Ok go easy on me, I am new to this :-) 

Using Claude, I built *Turtle Overdrive*, a mobile-first, browser-based endless arcade racer. Claude assisted the entire development lifecycle, and I hosted it on my WordPress website, including the leaderboard database. 

About the game: Steer your circuit-board turtle around oncoming hover-traffic, grab glowing chocolate turtles for points, and watch the city itself unravel as you survive. Speed ramps up the longer you last, the scene grows brighter and more saturated, and after the one-minute mark the road starts spawning laser barriers you have to thread through.

Equipped with a community leaderboard and soundtracked by “[Where Are The Turtles](https://namedrop.life/music/where-are-the-turtles/)” by NAME DROP.
